  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system treats past interactions as continuing interest in related products or content, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose of the next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a recent activity with a practical complement or a closely matched listening experience.",
    "Specific continuity in function, compatibility, artist, or musical character gives users a concrete reason to choose."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with closer matches despite requiring an unestablished project, upgrade, or change in taste.",
    "Related purchases are treated as continuing needs even when recommendations duplicate functions or supplies users already have.",
    "Older interests, including seasonal listening, receive weight despite more recent evidence of a different immediate preference."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, brand, ecosystem, and genre similarity substitutes for a specific reason to choose an item now.",
    "Past purchase or listening patterns are extended across products and content whose purposes or experiences differ materially."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent sequences indicate specific current tasks, moods, and desired experiences that broad historical affinity does not capture.",
    "Existing ownership, functional duplication, compatibility, dimensions, and quantity determine whether a related product adds useful capability.",
    "Users distinguish an appealing item from an immediate choice; deferring or skipping an item does not establish dislike.",
    "Unidentifiable content leaves preference alignment uncertain and should not be interpreted as confirmed content rejection."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items often share a broad connection with user history but lack the specific current purpose, complementary benefit, or experiential match needed to motivate a choice.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "Frequency of explicit immediate-choice endorsements among top-ranked recommendations, separated from general interest and deferred interest.",
    "Frequency of rejections attributed to duplicated ownership, incompatible requirements, unnecessary quantities, or unestablished tasks.",
    "Relative ranking of recommendations endorsed for a specific recent intent versus those supported only by broad historical similarity.",
    "Frequency of judgments withheld because content cannot be identified, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}
